design.prediction_inputs: Same-cell no-load and calibration V/Ca/T/lambda, plus target stress pulse definition
design.sealed_outputs: Two target V/Ca/T/lambda waveforms; read only for scoring
design.model_training: None: all three baselines are per-cell target-blind rules
design.cell_groups: Separate 12-cell source and 12-cell confirmation Latin-hypercube cohorts
design.physics: Exploratory 51-state embodied model; common nominal pre-paced initial state
design.event_definition: Descriptive threshold only: peak stress-induced delta V > 40 mV; not a biological arrhythmia diagnosis
design.caveat: Same-equation synthetic experiment. Stress law and mechanical parameters are not calibrated to paired human-cell records.
